summary.text: Bernadette Wilson is an Anchorage business owner who has not held elected office. She owns the trash-collection company Denali Disposal, previously directed the Alaska chapter of Americans for Prosperity, and has worked on more than a dozen political campaigns. She advocates restoring the statutory Permanent Fund dividend and has criticized relying on bipartisan legislative coalitions.

paragraphs.text: Born on the Kenai Peninsula and raised in Anchorage; great-niece of former Gov. Wally Hickel; owns Denali Disposal.
Hosted a talk-radio show until 2015; worked as Alaska director of Americans for Prosperity and for the Alaska Policy Forum.

Worked on more than a dozen campaigns, including Anchorage Mayor Dave Bronson's and a 2010 ballot measure requiring parental notification of a minor's abortion; advised Rep. Nick Begich's 2024 campaign; campaigning for a ballot measure to repeal ranked-choice voting (as of May 2025).

sources.title: Third Republican candidate, Bernadette Wilson, enters Alaska governor's race
